missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бок' is the nominative subject of 'болит'. 'Правый' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A common health complaint.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Бок' is the accusative after 'на', showing the side turned onto; this inanimate masculine noun keeps the nominative form. A sleeping-position phrase.
Strategic focus: Locative prepositional. 'На боку' uses the special locative ending '-у' after 'на' to show resting position. A classic second-prepositional form.

missions.phrase: У меня нет боли в боку.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Боком' is the instrumental showing which part touched. 'К стене' is the dative of direction. A vivid posture description.
Strategic focus: Dative of path. 'По боку' uses the dative 'боку' after 'по' to trace the seam along the side. 'Рубашки' is the genitive of possession. A tailoring detail.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural with a numeral. 'Бока' is the accusative plural after 'оба'; the masculine plural takes the stressed '-а' ending. A reaction of laughter or pain.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Бока' is the nominative plural subject of 'помялись', taking the irregular stressed '-а'. 'У коробки' is genitive of possession. A damage report.
